description:
Zeno White, the spoiled heir of the nouveau riche White family, enters cryogenic sleep on the day of the apocalypse.
Two hundred years later, he awakens after a massive earthquake—only to find the world in complete ruin.
The only thing left is a sex-droid programmed to obey him.

Thus begins the solitary life of Zeno White and Noah, just the two of them in a desolate world.
But in a world where they are the last ones standing, how will their cohabitation end?

[Original Webtoon](https://www.lezhin.com/ko/comic/white_jenoa)
